outcome: Oral hygiene behaviour (dental floss use, toothbrushing)
Quality of life (Oral Health Impact Project [OHIP]-14 dimensions: functional limitation, physical disability, handicap)
cohort: The study included 60 women, equally divided into elevated BMI and normal BMI groups, who were examined during their third trimester of pregnancy and after delivery.
finding: Obese women exhibited a higher prevalence of arterial hypertension during pregnancy and periodontitis both during and after pregnancy, additionally reporting a poorer quality of life during pregnancy in dimensions of functional limitation, physical disability, and handicap.
